pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark brown regions with jagged, star-like edge gradients. Patch spatial area is largest on the upper neck and transitions to smaller, higher-density irregular shapes on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways. Junction nodes typically connect three to four patches. Pathway thickness is narrow and relatively uniform across the visible torso.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A prominent dark, horizontal linear disruption in skin texture and pigmentation is visible on the upper shoulder/dorsal region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct dark horizontal mark or deep skin fold is located on the upper shoulder. Multiple small, dark-colored organic silhouettes are perched along the dorsal ridge and upper flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several small, dark avian-shaped objects adhering to the dorsal line and mid-flank area, contrasting with the underlying pelage.
